**DK25.2** is a medical diagnosis code that identifies an acute gastric ulcer presenting with both hemorrhage and perforation ("akut mavesår med blødning og perforation") [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system, this specific code is a critical component for monitoring patient safety and clinical outcomes, particularly for individuals being treated for [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1].

The code is formally embedded in the national clinical quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) via the Atrieflimren i Danmark (AFDK) database [^src2]. Its primary significance lies in its use for calculating the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among atrial fibrillation patients [^src3]. Because severe bleeding can occur in various anatomical systems, the AFDK methodology relies on a broad spectrum of ICD-10-DK codes to ensure comprehensive tracking. For gastrointestinal bleeding events, DK25.2 is utilized alongside a range of other ulcer and gastrointestinal codes (such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]], [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) [^src1]. This is combined with codes for intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]]–[[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) to form a complete picture of severe bleeding complications [^src1].

By consistently applying DK25.2 and its related diagnostic codes, Danish health authorities can accurately assess the risks associated with anticoagulant therapies and other medical interventions in atrial fibrillation populations [^src2]. The technical definition and application of this code have remained a stable part of the AFDK indicator methodology, as documented across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 annual reports [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
